full_name: Adriana Craciun | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Frances B. Cashin Fellow Boston University
bio: Adriana Craciun is the Emma MacLachlan Metcalf Chair of Humanities at Boston University and works at the intersections of Arctic humanities, environmental humanities, and the cultural history of science. At Radcliffe, she will explore how the increase in plant life, working in tandem with people, is transforming two very different Arctic places: Greenland and Svalbard.
